q: You are using a fire extinguisher. What is the right thing to do?
o: Stand very close in the smoke
Squeeze the handle
Aim at the top of the flames
Use a water extinguisher on an electrical fire
e: Correct: Squeeze the handle. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You see a small fire starting in a dustbin at school. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Let trained staff use the extinguisher
Tell a teacher immediately
Help others move away
Throw paper on it
e: 'Throw paper on it' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You notice that a classmate is sad and talks about hurting themself. What is the right thing to do?
o: Leave them alone
Stay with them and listen
Keep it secret
Make fun of them
e: Correct: Stay with them and listen. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Concentrated acid spills on your hand in the lab. What is the right thing to do?
o: Apply oil
Rub the skin hard
Wash under running water for at least 15 minutes
Wipe it with a dry cloth and continue
e: Correct: Wash under running water for at least 15 minutes. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are working in the school science laboratory. What is the right thing to do?
o: Follow the teacher's instructions
Taste chemicals to identify them
Eat food in the lab
Mix chemicals just to see what happens
e: Correct: Follow the teacher's instructions. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are working in the school science laboratory. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Wear safety goggles and a lab coat
Eat food in the lab
Wash your hands after the experiment
Report any spill or breakage at once
e: 'Eat food in the lab' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A gas cylinder's rubber tube catches fire. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Call the fire brigade (101/112)
Cover the flame with a wet sack
Throw the cylinder
Turn off the regulator if it is safe
e: 'Throw the cylinder' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are travelling by metro. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Stand behind the yellow line
Hold the handrail
Lean on the doors
Let passengers get off first
e: 'Lean on the doors' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A person is bleeding heavily from a cut on the arm. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Remove a cloth soaked with blood and keep changing it
Raise the arm above heart level if possible
Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth
Get medical help quickly
e: 'Remove a cloth soaked with blood and keep changing it' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A child has swallowed a household chemical (like floor cleaner). What is the right thing to do?
o: Hide the bottle
Rinse the mouth with water
Make the child vomit without medical advice
Give milk and wait at home
e: Correct: Rinse the mouth with water. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are heating water in a test tube in the school lab. What is the right thing to do?
o: Heat gently while shaking
Heat only the bottom strongly without shaking
Look into the tube while heating
Hold it with bare hands
e: Correct: Heat gently while shaking. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A gas cylinder's rubber tube catches fire. What is the right thing to do?
o: Panic and lock the door
Pour petrol to make it burn out
Turn off the regulator if it is safe
Throw the cylinder
e: Correct: Turn off the regulator if it is safe. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are playing online games. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Never share personal information
Take breaks and limit screen time
Play all night
Play only with known friends
e: 'Play all night' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You notice that a classmate is sad and talks about hurting themself. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Encourage them to talk to a counsellor
Stay with them and listen
Make fun of them
Tell a trusted adult right away
e: 'Make fun of them' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Concentrated acid spills on your hand in the lab. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Apply oil
Remove contaminated clothing
Inform the teacher
Wash under running water for at least 15 minutes
e: 'Apply oil' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A person is bleeding heavily from a cut on the arm. What is the right thing to do?
o: Raise the arm above heart level if possible
Remove a cloth soaked with blood and keep changing it
Leave the wound uncovered
Wash it with hot water for long
e: Correct: Raise the arm above heart level if possible. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A friend wants you to try a cigarette. What is the right thing to do?
o: Smoke where no one can see
Tell a trusted adult
Keep it a secret
Try it once to fit in
e: Correct: Tell a trusted adult. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A neighbour is burning plastic waste in the open. What is the right thing to do?
o: Add more plastic
Move away from the smoke
Breathe the smoke deeply
Stand near the fire
e: Correct: Move away from the smoke. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A neighbour is burning plastic waste in the open. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Move away from the smoke
Ask them to stop and explain the toxic smoke
Breathe the smoke deeply
Inform the municipality
e: 'Breathe the smoke deeply' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Mosquitoes are breeding near your house. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Remove stagnant water from coolers and pots
Store water in open containers
Wear full-sleeved clothes in the evening
Use mosquito nets and repellents
e: 'Store water in open containers' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You ride pillion on a motorcycle. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Ride three people on one bike
Wear a properly strapped helmet
Hold on firmly
Sit facing forward
e: 'Ride three people on one bike' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A friend wants to swim in a canal on a hot day. What is the right thing to do?
o: Jump in together
Suggest a supervised pool
Swim across for a bet
Swim after eating a big meal
e: Correct: Suggest a supervised pool. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are trapped in a smoke-filled room. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Crawl low under the smoke
Cover nose and mouth with a wet cloth
Feel doors with the back of your hand before opening
Stand up and walk
e: 'Stand up and walk' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are using a fire extinguisher. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Aim at the base of the fire
Use a water extinguisher on an electrical fire
Sweep from side to side
Squeeze the handle
e: 'Use a water extinguisher on an electrical fire' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are preparing for a school exam and feel very stressed. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Talk to parents or a teacher
Make a study plan
Take short breaks and sleep well
Stop eating
e: 'Stop eating' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You find a broken thermometer with silver droplets (mercury). Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Vacuum the droplets
Do not touch the droplets
Open windows and keep others away
Tell an adult
e: 'Vacuum the droplets' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.
